Mere disagreement does not make a source false. Fill all opaque keys.

A passage saying candidate X is the artist, born date, sport, population or symbol asked for is SUPPORT, never counterevidence merely because another passage gives Y. Set support to that passage, fit=direct, observed_slot to the requested role, and counter empty unless there is actual negation or role exclusion. Examples with invented names: two albums both called Evening, one by Mira and one by Noel, support BOTH artists. Two people called Alex born1901 and1873 support BOTH dates. A player practicing golf AND tennis supports BOTH sports. A passage saying London is a birthplace makes London a wrong_argument for a birth-DATE question. Distinguish an asserted false same-role answer from a type error. Before wrong_argument, verify the source actually attributes a DIFFERENT role. Do not invent a disagreement or unknown conflict just to fill the field; differing allowed entities are not contradictions.
